title: COMPONENTS
ocr_text:
COMPONENTS

Windshield Glass
Upper Moulding
Joint Cover
Lower Moulding
Side Moulding
Roof Headliner Front Trim
Front Pillar Garnish
Spacer
Wiper Arm
Inner Rear View Mirror

REMOVAL OF WINDSHIELD

1. REMOVE FRONT PILLAR GARNISH
(a) Pry out the clips with a screwdriver.

(b) Pull the garnish upward to remove it.

2. REMOVE FOLLOWING PARTS:
(a) Inner rear view mirror
(b) Roof headliner front trim

3. REMOVE WIPER ARM

4. REMOVE WINDSHIELD MOULDING (See page BO-12)
